title: AI slop movies are the new direct-to-video cash grabs
brief: Fountain 0 announced an AI-generated film adaptation of The Odyssey titled "Odysseus: The Fall," capitalizing on the buzz around Christopher Nolan's theatrical adaptation. The project exemplifies a growing trend of studios using generative AI to produce low-cost direct-to-video content, raising questions about content quality and market saturation in AI-generated entertainment.
